title: Math Registry Provenance Reconciliation

motivation.audit_result: Existing math_source_registry.json was identified as the foundational mathematical registry source.
motivation.conclusion: The warning is caused by registry naming divergence rather than loss of mathematical governance.

decision.strategy: Reconcile runtime expectations to the existing canonical registry instead of introducing a duplicate registry.

implementation: Update runtime and validators to reference registry/math_source_registry.json.
If backward compatibility is required, provide a compatibility alias or lightweight forwarding stub for registry/math_registry.json.
Record the naming reconciliation in governance_change_ledger.json.
Preserve complete provenance; do not duplicate mathematical registry contents.
acceptance_criteria: global_validate.py reports no missing math registry warning.
All runtime references resolve to math_source_registry.json.
Documentation reflects the reconciled canonical name.
notes: A source registry is architecturally preferable because it records authoritative origins rather than derived mathematical content.
Future semantic authority expansion can reference this registry directly.
